reason: Recipe step names (RebuildIndexProfile/ResetIndexProfile) and JSON property names (IndexIds/Indexes/Indices) are renamed with no backward-compatible aliasing, unlike other deprecated steps in the same codebase, so any existing recipe/deployment-plan JSON referencing the old step names or properties will silently no-op or lose selected index data after upgrade.
